application has one name field, and going back the other way is what makes a true cutover
hard ('de la Cruz' splits wrong). Carried as one string because that is what is known.

approval_posture.description:
The tenant's approval posture (`AshAgent.Approval.Posture`): which person
decides an approval. `:standard` unless a person changes it.
. Field included by default.

approval_posture_ends_at.description:
When the `:implementation` posture ends, after which it reads as
`:standard` (`AshAgent.Approval.Posture.effective/3`). Kept by no other
posture.
. Field included by default.

base_currency_id.description:
The tenant's reporting currency. Dataverse stores every monetary value
twice -- once in the transaction currency and once converted to this one --
so that cross-currency reporting does not have to join exchange rates.
. Field included by default.
